title: Consciousness is generated in the upper brainstem

statements.text: Removing the cortex does not abolish consciousness, while focal lesions of the upper brainstem do. Since without brainstem arousal there is no cortical consciousness but not the other way round, this double dissociation shows that consciousness is generated in the upper brainstem, with the periaqueductal gray as a nodal point.

sources.quote: we must conclude that consciousness is generated in the upper brainstem
In the absence of brainstem arousal there cannot be cortical consciousness, but the converse does not apply.
all consciousness ultimately derives from upper brainstem sources
